```{r}
load("~/_FCB/Summer25/Markov/Rdata/data_image1.RData")
# load packages needed by ALL chunks
library(dplyr)

library(ggplot2)
library(plotly)
library(scales)
library(reactable)
library(stringr)
library(gt)
library(forcats)   # << this was missing

make_heat_gt <- function(df, title, key_col = NULL,
                         palette = c("white", "steelblue")) {

  # Normalize to a data frame with an explicit Cohort column
  if (!is.null(key_col) && key_col %in% names(df)) {
    df2 <- df
    names(df2)[names(df2) == key_col] <- "Cohort"
  } else {
    if (is.null(rownames(df))) stop("Provide key_col when df has no rownames.")
    df2 <- tibble::rownames_to_column(as.data.frame(df), var = "Cohort")
  }

  # Split body rows vs. Total row for computing the color scale
  body_df   <- df2 %>% filter(Cohort != "Total")
  total_row <- df2 %>% filter(Cohort == "Total")

  # Numeric columns to color
  num_cols <- names(body_df)[sapply(body_df, is.numeric)]
  # Safe domain from body rows only
  rng <- range(as.matrix(body_df[, num_cols, drop = FALSE]), na.rm = TRUE)
  if (!is.finite(rng[1]) || !is.finite(rng[2])) rng <- c(0, 1)

  # Build gt from the full table (keeps Total visible)
  gt(df2, rowname_col = "Cohort") %>%
    fmt_number(columns = everything(), decimals = 0, sep_mark = ",") %>%
    sub_missing(columns = everything(), missing_text = "") %>%
    # Color only non-Total rows, with domain from non-Total rows
    data_color(
      columns = all_of(num_cols),
      rows    = Cohort != "Total",
      colors  = col_numeric(palette = palette, domain = rng, na.color = "transparent")
    ) %>%
    # Emphasize forecast columns
    tab_style(
      style = list(cell_text(style = "italic", weight = "bold")),
      locations = cells_body(columns = any_of(c("F25", "S26")))
    ) %>%
    # Optional: visually emphasize the Total row (no coloring already)
    tab_style(
      style = list(cell_text(weight = "bold")),
      locations = cells_body(rows = Cohort == "Total")
    ) %>%
    tab_header(title = title) %>%
    opt_row_striping()
}
```

# Page 2

```{r}
# 1) Prepare (order columns, tidy percent)
tbl <- fcbud_waterfall %>%
  mutate(
    Semester = as.integer(Semester),
    Group = ifelse(str_starts(Cohort, "FT"), "FT cohorts", 
                   ifelse(Cohort == "Total", "Totals", "TR cohorts")),
    Pct_of_Total = Pct_of_Total/100  # convert to proportion if it's in %
  ) %>%
  select(Group, Cohort, Semester, F23, F24, Diff, Pct_of_Total, A, B, C, D, E)

# 2) Build a handsome gt table
gt(tbl, groupname_col = "Group") %>%
  tab_header(
    title = md("**FCB upper-division headcount change: F23 → F24**"),
    subtitle = "Waterfall rows with factor decomposition (A–E)"
  ) %>%
  tab_spanner(label = "Factors (Δ decomposition)", columns = c(A, B, C, D, E)) %>%
  cols_label(
    Cohort = "Cohort (pair)",
    Semester = "Semester",
    F23 = "F23",
    F24 = "F24",
    Diff = "Δ",
    Pct_of_Total = "% of total",
    A = "Admissions", B = "% FCB", C = "Retention",
    D = "Net transfers", E = "Promotion"
  ) %>%
  fmt_number(columns = c(F23, F24, Diff, A:E), decimals = 0, use_seps = TRUE) %>%
  fmt_percent(columns = Pct_of_Total, decimals = 1) %>%
  data_color(
    columns = Diff,
    colors = scales::col_bin(
      palette = c("#d95f02","#f0f0f0","#1b9e77"),
      domain = c(min(tbl$Diff, na.rm=TRUE), max(tbl$Diff, na.rm=TRUE)),
      bins = c(-Inf, 0, Inf)
    )
  ) %>%
  tab_style(
    style = list(cell_text(weight = "bold")),
    locations = cells_row_groups(groups = "Totals")
  ) %>%
  tab_options(table.font.size = px(14)) %>%
  opt_row_striping()
```

# Page 3

```{r}
## Classic Waterfall F23 --> F24

make_waterfall_topk_df <- function(fcbud_waterfall,
                                   term1 = "F23",
                                   term2 = "F24",
                                   top_k = 10,
                                   order_by = c("abs_diff","pct","diff"),
                                   verbose = TRUE) {
  order_by <- match.arg(order_by)
  
  # Split rows
  has_total_row <- any(fcbud_waterfall$Cohort == "Total")
  cohorts_only  <- fcbud_waterfall %>% filter(Cohort != "Total")
  
  # Totals (use Total row if present)
  if (has_total_row) {
    total_t1 <- fcbud_waterfall[[term1]][fcbud_waterfall$Cohort == "Total"]
    total_t2 <- fcbud_waterfall[[term2]][fcbud_waterfall$Cohort == "Total"]
  } else {
    total_t1 <- sum(cohorts_only[[term1]], na.rm = TRUE)
    total_t2 <- sum(cohorts_only[[term2]], na.rm = TRUE)
  }
  total_delta <- total_t2 - total_t1
  
  # Build a lookup of Cohort → Semester for labeling
  sem_lookup <- fcbud_waterfall %>%
    filter(Cohort != "Total") %>%
    distinct(Cohort, Semester)
  
  # Order (with % fallback)
  core <- cohorts_only %>%
    mutate(
      pct_used  = ifelse(is.na(Pct_of_Total), 100 * Diff / total_delta, Pct_of_Total),
      order_key = case_when(
        order_by == "abs_diff" ~ abs(Diff),
        order_by == "pct"      ~ abs(pct_used),
        TRUE                   ~ Diff
      )
    ) %>%
    arrange(desc(order_key)) %>%
    # ensure Semester is present (if your table already has it, this is harmless)
    left_join(sem_lookup, by = "Cohort")
  
  n_avail <- nrow(core)
  top_k   <- min(top_k, n_avail)
  
  # Build a lookup: Cohort -> Semester (from the already-built table)
  sem_map <- with(
    fcbud_waterfall %>% dplyr::filter(Cohort != "Total"),
    stats::setNames(Semester, Cohort)
  )
  
  # Top-K with (S#) labels via the lookup (no joins, no ambiguity)
  top <- core %>%
    dplyr::slice_head(n = top_k) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      Sem_for_label = sem_map[Cohort],                 # vectorized lookup
      label = ifelse(
        is.na(Sem_for_label),
        Cohort,                                       # fallback if missing
        paste0(Cohort, " (S", as.integer(Sem_for_label), ")")
      )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      step = Cohort,
      label = label,
      value = Diff,
      type  = ifelse(Diff >= 0, "Increase", "Decrease")
    )
  
  
  # “Other” to force Start + steps = End (full)
  other_sum <- total_delta - sum(top$value, na.rm = TRUE)
  contrib <- if (abs(other_sum) > 0) {
    bind_rows(
      top,
      tibble(step = "Other", label = "Other", value = other_sum,
             type = ifelse(other_sum >= 0, "Increase", "Decrease"))
    )
  } else top
  
  if (verbose) {
    message(sprintf("Top-K selected: %d (of %d). 'Other' = %+d. Sum(top + other) = %+d. Full Δ = %+d.",
                    top_k, n_avail, round(other_sum),
                    round(sum(contrib$value, na.rm = TRUE)), round(total_delta)))
  }
  
  # Build sequence: Start → contributions → End
  seq_df <- bind_rows(
    tibble(step = "Start", label = term1, value = total_t1, type = "Start"),
    contrib,
    tibble(step = "End",   label = term2, value = total_t2, type = "End")
  )
  
  # Floating bases via running total
  running <- total_t1
  ymin <- numeric(nrow(seq_df)); ymax <- numeric(nrow(seq_df))
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(seq_df))) {
    tp  <- seq_df$type[i]; val <- seq_df$value[i]
    if (tp == "Start") { ymin[i] <- 0; ymax[i] <- total_t1; running <- total_t1 }
    else if (tp %in% c("Increase","Decrease")) { ymin[i] <- running; running <- running + val; ymax[i] <- running }
    else if (tp == "End") { ymin[i] <- 0; ymax[i] <- total_t2 }
  }
  
  seq_df$ymin <- ymin; seq_df$ymax <- ymax
  seq_df$x    <- seq_along(seq_df$step)
  seq_df$xmin <- seq_df$x - 0.42
  seq_df$xmax <- seq_df$x + 0.42
  seq_df
}



plot_waterfall_topk <- function(wf_df, y_floor = NULL) {
  # If using a y-floor, clamp bar bases so they render (avoids “removed rows”)
  if (!is.null(y_floor)) {
    wf_df <- wf_df %>%
      mutate(
        ymin_plot = pmax(ymin, y_floor),
        ymax_plot = pmax(ymax, y_floor)
      ) %>%
      # For Start/End, draw from floor to total (so the grey bars show)
      mutate(
        ymin_plot = ifelse(type %in% c("Start","End"), y_floor, ymin_plot)
      )
  } else {
    wf_df <- wf_df %>% mutate(ymin_plot = ymin, ymax_plot = ymax)
  }
  
  # connectors (also clamp to floor when present)
  connectors <- wf_df %>%
    filter(type %in% c("Increase","Decrease")) %>%
    transmute(
      x = x, xend = x + 1,
      y = if (!is.null(y_floor)) pmax(ymax, y_floor) else ymax,
      yend = if (!is.null(y_floor)) pmax(ymax, y_floor) else ymax
    )
  
  ggplot(wf_df) +
    geom_rect(aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = ymin_plot, ymax = ymax_plot, fill = type)) +
    geom_segment(data = connectors, aes(x = x, xend = xend, y = y, yend = yend),
                 linewidth = 0.35, color = "grey55") +
    geom_text(
      data = subset(wf_df, type %in% c("Start","End")),
      aes(x = x, y = ymax_plot, label = comma(round(value))),
      vjust = -0.35, size = 3.5
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = wf_df$x, labels = wf_df$label,
                       expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.08))) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = comma,
                       limits = if (!is.null(y_floor)) c(y_floor, NA) else NULL) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("Start"="#6b6b6b","Increase"="#1b9e77",
                                 "Decrease"="#d95f02","End"="#4a4a4a")) +
    labs(
      x = NULL, y = "Headcount",
      title = "FCB upper-division headcount",
      subtitle = "Cohort contributions to change F23 → F24"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(legend.position = "none",
          axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 28, hjust = 1),
          panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
}

wf_df <- make_waterfall_topk_df(
  fcbud_waterfall,
  term1 = "F23", term2 = "F24",
  top_k = 5,               # try 5, 8, 12, etc.
  order_by = "abs_diff",   # or "pct" / "diff"
  verbose = TRUE
)

# sanity: steps equal full change
with(wf_df, {
  steps <- sum(value[type %in% c("Increase","Decrease")], na.rm = TRUE)
  delta <- value[type=="End"] - value[type=="Start"]
  message(sprintf("Sum of steps = %d | End-Start = %d", round(steps), round(delta)))
})


# 1) Make hover strings on wf_df
wf_df <- wf_df %>%
  mutate(
    hover = dplyr::case_when(
      type %in% c("Start","End") ~ paste0(label, ": ", comma(round(value))),
      TRUE ~ paste0(label, "<br>Δ = ", comma(round(value)))
    )
  )

# 2) Rebuild the ggplot with text mapped on the SAME geom_rect layer
plot_waterfall_topk_interactive <- function(wf_df, y_floor = NULL) {
  df <- wf_df

  if (!is.null(y_floor)) {
    df <- df %>%
      mutate(
        ymin_plot = pmax(ymin, y_floor),
        ymax_plot = pmax(ymax, y_floor),
        ymin_plot = ifelse(type %in% c("Start","End"), y_floor, ymin_plot)
      )
  } else {
    df <- df %>% mutate(ymin_plot = ymin, ymax_plot = ymax)
  }

  connectors <- df %>%
    filter(type %in% c("Increase","Decrease")) %>%
    transmute(
      x = x, xend = x + 1,
      y = if (!is.null(y_floor)) pmax(ymax, y_floor) else ymax,
      yend = if (!is.null(y_floor)) pmax(ymax, y_floor) else ymax
    )

  p <- ggplot(df) +
    # <- text is mapped here, on the SAME rect layer with xmin/xmax/ymin/ymax
    geom_rect(aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = ymin_plot, ymax = ymax_plot,
                  fill = type, text = hover)) +
    geom_segment(data = connectors, aes(x = x, xend = xend, y = y, yend = yend),
                 linewidth = 0.35, color = "grey55") +
    geom_text(
      data = subset(df, type %in% c("Start","End")),
      aes(x = x, y = ymax_plot, label = comma(round(value))),
      vjust = -0.35, size = 3.5
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = df$x, labels = df$label,
                       expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.08))) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = comma,
                       limits = if (!is.null(y_floor)) c(y_floor, NA) else NULL) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("Start"="#6b6b6b","Increase"="#1b9e77",
                                 "Decrease"="#d95f02","End"="#4a4a4a")) +
    labs(
      x = NULL, y = "Headcount",
      title = "FCB upper-division headcount",
      subtitle = "Cohort contributions to change F23 → F24"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(legend.position = "none",
          axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 28, hjust = 1),
          panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

  ggplotly(p, tooltip = "text")
}

# 3) Use it
plot_waterfall_topk_interactive(wf_df, y_floor = 2500)

```

# Page 4

```{r}

# --- 1) Build a tidy long table from your waterfall (A–E columns) ---
# Assumes fcbud_waterfall has: Cohort, Semester, Diff, A,B,C,D,E, Pct_of_Total
# Pick the same rows you plotted earlier (e.g., Top-K by |Diff|)
top_k <- 5
wf_long <- fcbud_waterfall %>%
  filter(Cohort != "Total") %>%
  arrange(desc(abs(Diff))) %>%
  slice_head(n = top_k) %>%
  mutate(Label = paste0(Cohort, " (S", Semester, ")")) %>%
  select(Label, Cohort, Semester, Diff, `Admissions`=A, `% FCB`=B, `Retention`=C, `Net transfers`=D, `Promotion`=E) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(`Admissions`,`% FCB`,`Retention`,`Net transfers`,`Promotion`),
               names_to = "Factor", values_to = "Contribution") %>%
  # Nice hover text
  mutate(hover = paste0(
    Label, "<br>",
    Factor, ": ", comma(round(Contribution)), "<br>",
    "Total contribution (Δ): ", comma(round(Diff))
  ))

# order x by total absolute contribution, newest on left if you prefer
wf_long <- wf_long %>%
  group_by(Label) %>% mutate(abs_tot = first(abs(Diff))) %>% ungroup() %>%
  mutate(Label = factor(Label, levels = unique(Label[order(-abs_tot)])))

# --- 2) ggplot (your existing stacked chart), just add aes(text=hover) ---
p_stack <- ggplot(wf_long, aes(x = Label, y = Contribution, fill = Factor, text = hover)) +
  geom_col(position = "stack", width = 0.75) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "grey60", linewidth = 0.5) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = comma) +
  labs(
    title = "Decomposition of cohort contributions to change F23 → F24",
    subtitle = "Positive (above zero) and negative (below zero)",
    x = NULL, y = "Headcount contribution", fill = "Factors"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 28, hjust = 1)
  )

# --- 3) Make it interactive ---
ggplotly(p_stack, tooltip = "text")

```
